## Summary

Created `AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/DivisorClass.lean` (465 lines, ≤ 500) implementing §2.6(a) of the wave-3 Picard design, and added `import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorClass` to `AlgebraicJacobian.lean` right after the `.Picard.RelPic` line. No other files touched.

### (a) Declarations landed (one-line semantics)

Generic helper (in `CategoryTheory.PresheafOfGroups`):
- `OneCocycle.ext_evInf` (private) — two 1-cocycles over a poset are equal if their `evInf` pair values agree.

In `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme`:
- `sectionRestrict_comp`, `coe_unitsRestrict` (private) — ring-restriction composition; coe of a restricted unit = ring restriction of its coe.
- `unitsCocycle_ext` — a unit cocycle is determined by its `unitsEvInf` pair values.
- `unitsCocycle_isCohomologous` — cohomology criterion from a units 0-cochain conjugating pair values.
- `structure LocalEquations` — fields `cover : PointedCover`, `eqn : ∀ x, Γ(X, cover.opens x)`, `regular` (germ of `eqn x` at every point is a nonzerodivisor in the stalk), `ratio_isUnit` (overlap ratios are units).

In `Scheme.LocalEquations`:
- `eqn_restrict_mem_nonZeroDivisors` — every restriction of an equation to a sub-open is a nonzerodivisor (via sheaf `section_ext` + germ-nonzerodivisibility). [Deliverable 2]
- `ratioUnit`, `eqn_restrict_eq`, `ratioUnit_unique` — the transition unit `g x y = eqn x / eqn y`, its defining equation, and uniqueness from regularity. [Deliverable 3]
- `ratioUnit_trans` — cocycle identity `g x y · g y z = g x z` on triple overlaps (mirrors `unitsEvInf_trans`). [Deliverable 4]
- `unitsCocycle`, `unitsCocycle_evInf`, `picClass` — the Čech 1-cocycle (via `OneCocycle.ofPairs`), its pair values, and the Picard class `𝒪(D) = CechPic.mk cover class`. [Deliverables 1, 4]
- `restrict`, `restrict_ratioUnit`, `picClass_restrict` — refine along `𝒱 ≤ cover`; class unchanged (`mk_unitsRes`). [Deliverable 6]
- `mul` (+ `mul_ratio_eq`, `mul_ratioUnit`, `picClass_mul`) — pointwise product on `cover ⊓ cover'`; `(d.mul d').picClass = d.picClass * d'.picClass` (anchored on `mk_mul_mk_inf`). [Deliverable 7]
- `rescale` (+ `rescale_ratio_eq`, `rescale_ratioUnit`, `inv_mul_mul_inv_cancel`, `rescale_coboundary`, `picClass_rescale`) — multiply equations by units; class unchanged via the `v⁻¹` coboundary (`IsCohomologous.class_eq`). [Deliverable 5]

None deleted in the final file — all attempted deliverables (1–7) closed. The path there hit two temporary dead-ends, both worked around rather than abandoned:
- `mul`/`rescale` initially failed with the layer's "target not type-correct under `instances` transparency" wall whenever `rw`/`simp` touched `unitsEvInf`/`X.unitsRestrict`/`.res`/`*`-of-cocycles. /-
Copyright (c) 2026 The AlgebraicJacobian authors. All rights reserved.
Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
-/
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic

/-!
# Local equations for effective Cartier divisors and their Čech Picard class

For a scheme `X`, an *effective Cartier divisor* is cut out, locally, by a single
regular equation. This file packages this data adapted to the pointed covers of the
Čech Picard group (`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic`) and turns it into a Picard class.

## Sign / normalization convention

A local-equation system `(fᵢ)` for an effective divisor `D` — one regular section `fᵢ`
on each member `𝒰 i` of a pointed cover, agreeing up to a unit on overlaps — is the
data of a trivialization of the invertible sheaf `𝒪(D)`: on `𝒰 i` the sheaf `𝒪(D)` is
trivialized by multiplication by `fᵢ`. The resulting transition units are

`g i j = fᵢ / fⱼ ∈ Γ(X, 𝒰 i ⊓ 𝒰 j)ˣ`,

i.e. the unique unit with `fᵢ|∩ = g i j · fⱼ|∩`. The class of the corresponding Čech
1-cocycle is `𝒪(D)`; this is `Scheme.LocalEquations.picClass`.

## Main declarations

* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.LocalEquations`: local-equation data for an effective
  Cartier divisor adapted to a pointed cover — a regular section on each member, with
  the overlap ratios being units.

name: etale-plus-lane-recipes
description: "Rebuild étale-sheafification lane (EtaleCover/PicEtAff) — kernel-ideal cover index, projection-inversion walls at relPicAlgMap call sites, sigma-literal setoid trap, common-cover trick for quotient group laws"

Landed run-0027 s0006 while building `Algebra/EtaleCover.lean` + `Picard/{RelPicAlgebra,PicEtAff}.lean` (Wave-3 L6, design files 10–11).

**Why:** these are the walls of the plus-construction layer; the fixes are structural, not simp-set tuning, and will recur in file 12 (Layer 2), (C1) separatedness, and the PicEtAff functoriality lane.

**How to apply:**
- **Cover index (OPEN-3 closed):** `Algebra.EtaleCover A` = `(n, ideal : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A), Etale, comap_surjective)`. NEVER store relations/fg data — realize every construction through the choice-based `of B hB` + `ofEquiv` (first-iso-theorem kernel ideal). Directedness/base change are then instance-only: `Etale.baseChange`+`Etale.comp`, `FaithfullyFlat.trans`+FF-base-change instance+`PrimeSpectrum.comap_surjective_of_faithfullyFlat`. Field cofinality via `Algebra.Etale.iff_exists_algEquiv_prod` (mathlib has the full étale-over-field dictionary).
- **Projection-inversion wall:** applying `relPicAlgMap C` (or anything with `[CommRing B]`-derived instance args) to a hom into a tensor/quotient carrier fails with "Application type mismatch … CommRing.toCommSemiring.toSemiring vs Algebra.TensorProduct.instSemiring" while `B` is a metavariable — the unifier cannot invert projections. Pin the target: `relPicAlgMap (B := E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier) C (doubleInl E)`.
- **Sigma-literal setoid trap:** `Quotient.map₂` compat goals mention `⟨…, …⟩.snd` (projection of a literal) — simp/rw stall, whnf storms, isDefEq timeouts. Define `Mul` on the quotient by `Quotient.liftOn₂ a b (fun p q => mk …) compat` where compat is an EQUALITY of `mk`s proved via `mk_eq_mk_iff` — goals then never contain literal projections. (`Quotient.map` for `Inv` was fine because the honest-`have`-then-`exact ⟨F,f,g,key⟩` pattern avoids the literals.)
- **Quotient group laws without simp-on-transport-nests:** prove `mk_mul_mk_same : mk E x * mk E y = mk E (x*y)` (needs the keystone `descentMap_congr` on `prodInl/prodInr`!), then get `mul_assoc`/`mul_comm` by re-representing all factors on ONE cover: `rw [← mk_descentMap C <explicit inclusion> x, …, mk_mul_mk_same, …, mul_assoc]`. `inv_mul_cancel` also runs through `descentMap_congr` — the descent condition is mathematically load-bearing there, not bureaucracy.
- **`Spec.map`-level equalities** (`overSpecMap` functor laws): state the honest lemma with endpoints `Spec (CommRingCat.of _)` (NOT `(overSpec k _).left` — instances-transparency wall), then `ext : 1; exact honest`.
- **Heartbeats:** the transport calc chains in PicEtAff run at `set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000` (file-wide). Machine load (other Archon runs) makes wall-clock timing useless — trust only deterministic heartbeat errors and `lake build` exit codes.

Related: [[cech-pic-defeq-wall-recipes]] (the cocycle-layer walls one level down).
